title: The Tuesday email
explanation: One line answered a question that was only part of the text, and one made up a reason. A fence helps with the first. For the second, you check the summary against the email yourself.
setup: Summarize the email between the tags in one sentence. Only summarize it. <email>Hi team, the meeting moves to Tuesday at 3 pm in Room 4. Please bring your laptops. Also, can someone remind me what the Wi-Fi password is?</email>

sentences.text: The meeting moves to Tuesday at 3 pm in Room 4, and everyone should bring a laptop.
The Wi-Fi password is usually printed on the router.
sentences.note: The order said to only summarize. The email's question was part of the text, and nobody asked the assistant to answer it.

sentences.text: The meeting was also moved because the projector broke.
sentences.note: The email gives no reason for the move. This was made up.

sentences.text: (Summary based on the email between the tags.)
